 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Why choose one chain when you can have two timeless styles in one combo? The Royal Chain Combo brings together a 24K Gold Toned Satellite Chain and a Silver Braided Flat Chain, giving you the perfect balance of minimal elegance and bold everyday style.

The Gold Satellite Chain (50 cm) adds a sleek and graceful touch to your neckline. Its fine chain design with subtle detailing gives it a clean, polished, and lightweight look that is easy to wear every day. It works beautifully on its own for a soft minimal finish or can be paired with pendants for a more styled look.

The Silver Braided Flat Chain (4.5 mm) brings a stronger and more statement feel to the combo. Its braided flat pattern gives it a structured, stylish, and premium appearance, making it perfect for those who like jewellery that stands out while still looking refined.

Together, these two chains give you two different styling moods in one set — one light, sleek, and elegant, and the other bold, polished, and confident. Wear them separately according to your outfit or style preference, or keep both in your collection for everyday and occasion-based styling.

This combo is perfect for casual looks, office wear, festive dressing, evening outfits, gifting, and repeat everyday use.

A stylish two-chain combo made for those who love classic jewellery with versatile styling value.

Styling Tip: Wear the Satellite Chain for a clean minimal look, and switch to the Silver Braided Flat Chain when you want a bolder and more statement neckline.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Can I wear these chains daily?

Yes, these chains are suitable for daily styling as well as special occasions.

Q2. Can I wear these chains with pendants?

Yes, you can wear them alone or pair them with your favourite pendants for a more personalised look.

Q3. Can I style both chains separately?

Yes, you can wear each chain separately according to your outfit, mood, or occasion.

Q4. Are these chains party ready?

Yes, these chains are perfect for parties, festive looks, evening outfits, celebrations, and everyday premium styling.

Q5. Do these chains have an anti-tarnish finish?

Yes, they come with an anti-tarnish finish that helps maintain shine with proper care.

Q6. Are these chains comfortable to wear?

Yes, they are designed to feel smooth, stylish, and comfortable for regular wear.

Q7. Is this chain combo good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a stylish and thoughtful gift for someone who loves premium jewellery.

Q8. How should I care for these chains?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently after use and store them separately.
